description: This file defines the CodecProvider class in the Orleans.Serialization.Serializers namespace, responsible for providing serializers, coders, activators, and copiers for various types within the Orleans framework. It manages dependencies, supports dynamic codec and copier creation, and interacts with dependency injection to retrieve required services and configurations.

classes.name: CodecProvider
classes.description: A provider class that supplies serializers, copiers, and activators for types, utilizing dependency injection, caching, and dynamic creation capabilities.

methods.name: Constructor
methods.description: Initializes the CodecProvider instance with dependencies and loads configuration metadata.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Loads generalized and specialized codecs and copiers from DI services if not already initialized.

methods.name: ConsumeMetadata
methods.description: Processes configuration to map types to their respective codecs, copiers, activators, etc.

methods.name: TryGetCodec
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a codec of type TField from cache or creates it if absent.

methods.name: GetCodec
methods.description: Retrieves a codec for the specified type, throwing if not found.

methods.name: TryGetCodec(Type)
methods.description: Attempts to find a codec for a given runtime type.

methods.name: GetCodec(Type)
methods.description: Retrieves a codec for a runtime type, throwing if not found.

methods.name: GetCodec<T>
methods.description: Retrieves a typed codec, throwing if not found.

methods.name: GetActivator<T>
methods.description: Gets an activator for type T, used for instantiating objects.

methods.name: TryCreateBaseCodec
methods.description: Attempts to create a base codec for a type.

methods.name: GetBaseCodec<T>
methods.description: Retrieves the base codec for type T, throwing if not found.

methods.name: GetValueSerializer<T>
methods.description: Retrieves the value serializer for value types, throwing if not available.

methods.name: GetBaseCopier<T>
methods.description: Retrieves the base copier for reference types, throwing if not available.

methods.name: GetDeepCopier<T>
methods.description: Gets a deep copier for type T, throwing if not found.

methods.name: TryGetDeepCopier<T>
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a deep copier of type T.

methods.name: GetDeepCopier
methods.description: Retrieves a deep copier for a runtime type.

methods.name: TryGetDeepCopier
methods.description: Attempts to find a deep copier for a runtime type.

methods.name: CreateCodecInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of a codec for a specific type.

methods.name: CreateBaseCodecInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of a base codec for a specific type.

methods.name: CreateCopierInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of a copier for a specific type.

methods.name: GetServiceOrCreateInstance
methods.description: Resolves a service from DI or creates a new instance via Activator.

methods.name: GetValueSerializerInner
methods.description: Resolves a value serializer for a concrete type.

methods.name: GetBaseCopierInner
methods.description: Resolves a base copier for a concrete type.

methods.name: GetActivatorInner
methods.description: Resolves an activator for a concrete type.
